standard_prerequisites.name: For a flat morphism of finite presentation the cohomology of the derived pullback is computed by the derived tensor of the pushforward of the structure sheaf, functorially in K
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts RGamma(U, Lf^*K) into RGamma(X, Rf_*O_U tensor^L K), the input to the colimit argument.

standard_prerequisites.name: The global sections functor on a quasi-compact separated scheme commutes with homotopy colimits because it commutes with direct sums, and tensoring with a fixed complex commutes with derived colimits because direct sums in the derived category are computed termwise
standard_prerequisites.use: Justifies passing the homotopy colimit through both sides of the desired identity.

standard_prerequisites.name: Morphisms of finite presentation and flatness descend along the approximation of the base ring by finitely generated subrings, and the derived pullback of the pushforward recovers the original pushforward under base change
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces to the case where U and X are of finite type over Z.

standard_prerequisites.name: For a morphism of finite type over Z the pushforward of the structure sheaf is a homotopy colimit of perfect complexes as soon as the sheaves R^if_*O_U have countable sets of sections over affine opens, and the structure sheaf satisfies this countability
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the existence of the system of perfect objects E_n in the finite type case.

core_obligations: Reduce both statements to a colimit statement: by Lemma cohomology-base-change we have RGamma(U, Lf^*K) = RGamma(X, Rf_*O_U tensor^L K) functorially in K; since RGamma(X, -) commutes with homotopy colimits (it commutes with direct sums by Lemma quasi-coherence-pushforward-direct-sums) and - tensor^L K commutes with derived colimits, it suffices for (2) to write Rf_*O_U = hocolim E_n with E_n perfect; then (1) follows by setting L_n = E_n^dual, see Cohomology, Lemma dual-perfect-complex (proof lines 8629-8646).

Descend to finite type over Z: write A = colim A_i with A_i of finite type over Z; by Limits, Lemma descend-finite-presentation find i and morphisms U_i to X_i to Spec(A_i) of finite presentation recovering U to X to Spec(A) after base change; after enlarging i assume f_i flat by Limits, Lemma descend-flat-finite-presentation; by Lemma compare-base-change the derived pullback of Rf_{i,*}O_{U_i} along g : X to X_i is Rf_*O_U; since Lg^* commutes with derived colimits, it suffices to prove the statement for f_i (proof lines 8647-8660).

Handle the finite type case: by Lemma countable it suffices to show R^if_*O_U has countable sets of sections over affine opens, which follows from Lemma countable-cohomology applied to the structure sheaf; this completes the proof that Rf_*O_U is a homotopy colimit of perfect complexes (proof lines 8661-8670).
proof_roadmap: Reduce (2) to writing Rf_*O_U as a homotopy colimit of perfects and get (1) by duality (proof lines 8629-8646).
Approximate the base ring and descend U, X and flatness to finite type over Z (proof lines 8647-8660).
Conclude by the countability criterion for pushforwards of the structure sheaf (proof lines 8661-8670).
